_readme: S419 SkyCottonwood, 2026-10-18. Eleven of Cañada's 73 extracted records place no listed course (summary.json: failed.coverage 11; the load kept 62). Each model note says the text it was handed holds a sibling's section: the CA Business Assistant's pages 148-151 print the AS Business Assistant, the AS Business Administration's pages 165-166 print the Computer Science certificates. The business certificates share pages 148-154, and the PDF picker (_pdf_pick) chose a run that covers the listed codes without the program's own heading. This read prints the pages whose text names any of the eleven sections' headings (the catalog heads a section 'CA <Title>' or 'AS <Title>'), the contents lines among them, so the picker's fix can be built and tested on the catalog's own words. One load of the hand-filed copy (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/ca_ada.json; robots.txt refuses the college's /current/), no model call. Second read (19:40Z): the first printed two pages, 148 and 150, because the catalog's text carries two spaces after the award's letters ('AS  Business Assistant') and the patterns allowed one; every pattern now reads any spacing, and two name a certificate heading in words beside the title in case the certificates are headed otherwise.

questions.sections: Which PDF page prints each of the eleven programs' own section heading, and which other programs share that page.
